## Instructions

1. Soak peas overnight; drain.
2. Put peas, water, salt pork and vegetables in a big pot.
3. Bring to a boil and skim.
4. Simmer 3 hours, stirring so it does not stick.
5. Season at the end.

## Notes

Use the Easter ham bone.
